name: devops
description: DevOps toolkit for Claude Code. Bundles skill-git-standard (team Git/GitHub standards: 3-tier branch model, credential gate, Conventional Commits, PR-only protected main) and skill-docker-standard (containerization standard: 2-role model, no-credentials-in-image, build-official-image-from-main CI/CD to a private registry). More to come (SSL/TLS).
